18005864.reason: Accumulates every leading odd flower until it encounters an even flower, without enforcing odd total parity. For [5,7], prints 12 although the optimal odd bouquet is 7.

33588642.reason: Pairs even and odd flowers while forgetting parity of the count of included odd flowers, and uses original a indices in its leftover branch. [4,3,1,2] incorrectly includes both odds, printing even total 10 instead of 9.

35925076.reason: Greedily keeps a partial total odd and skips even flowers encountered before the first odd. [4,3,1,2] loses the leading 4 and returns 5 instead of 9.

37142506.reason: When there are more odds than evens, limits included odds using the number of even flowers, which is unrelated to odd-sum feasibility. The recorded 100-flower case returns 121 instead of 5193.

39007570.reason: Rejects each addition that would make the current partial sum even, so an initial even flower is permanently lost even though it belongs in the final optimum. [4,3,1,2] returns 5 instead of 9.
